notes: Strip e: x 6500-7930 plus ~300 px overlap (6200-8230). N-S streets: Hackberry Street (x ~6592 at Hewitt drifting to ~6471 at Taft; printed only 'STREET' north of Madison and HACKBERRY south of Madison on the same alignment, recorded as Hackberry throughout; thin in-street line along it), Cleinview Avenue (Dexter to Taft and beyond, 50 ft; printed only 'AVE.' north of Madison and CLEINVIEW south of Madison, same alignment with a ~26 px jog at Madison; the northern part's name is an inference), Fairfield Avenue (Hewitt to Madison; printed FAIRFIELD ... AVE.; jogs ~165 px east at y ~1580-1668 between Fairfax and Dexter, recorded as two bends; carries an in-street line near its middle), Dexter Place (22 ft, Dexter Avenue to Madison), Johns Place (Madison south, curving SW to a dead end), Keys Crescent (40 ft from Madison, curving ESE). E-W streets: Hewitt Avenue (top edge), Kinney Avenue, Fairfax Avenue, Dexter Avenue, Lincoln Avenue (ends at Fairfield), Fernwood Street (Hackberry to Cleinview), Madison Road (diagonal, rising to the east ~0.17), Clayton Street (jogs ~115 px at Hackberry: west section y~5238, east section y~5352), Taft Street (bottom edge, south side cut by the plate edge; suffix from the ST. printed at x~9100, same as strip c's choice). The plate is turned slightly: N-S streets drift ~-0.02 x per px of y, E-W streets slope down to the east. Not picked: the PRIVATE DRIVE (x ~7961-8000) running south from Keys Crescent's bend to Taft (private, not a street). Spaced letters MARSHALL'S EST., HELEBUSCH, ARMSTRONG'S, SCHMIDT & KLEIN, VERNON'S, etc. are owner/subdivision labels, not streets.
